svg.title: Alur & Felice Planner: system architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture: a React single-page app in the browser calls an Express API over JSON. The API reads and writes one SQLite database that holds Felice and Alur separately, and builds combined master reports.
svg.text: React single-page app → Express 5 API → SQLite. One database holds Felice and Alur separately; the master view combines them read-only.
Signs in with one shared password. Works inside
Felice, inside Alur, or in the combined master view.
In: the original planner layout, or a file exported from the app.

• request(): adds the X-Requested-With: felice header, sends the session cookie, and turns any 401 into the sign-in screen.
• api.org(slug): weeks · items · recurring · reports · actuals · rider prices & riders · import, scoped to one organisation.
• api.master: combined summary · top · compare · variance · export. api.me / login / logout / organisations.
API SERVER · Node.js 24+ / Express 5 · TypeScript runs natively (no build step)

The price is kept as calculated; the total is the line's rider cost.
Money is stored as whole cents. Deleting a week deletes its items. Before any schema upgrade the app writes a backup copy: planner.db.before-organisations-….bak
